Original finely hand-painted realistic medieval fantasy battlemap style: warm worn timber, stone, iron, linen, leather, delicate crisp contours, rich small-scale texture and earthy muted colors. No text, grid, watermark, people, tokens, ruler, background ground patch, glossy plastic, cartoon or isometric render. North/back is image TOP. Subject: closed travel trunk wrapped in worn ochre leather with three wide buckled straps and reinforced dark corners. Physical footprint ratio 1.4:0.85.
